nodes.label: Build a farm pack
nodes.description: Pipeline: transcribe (MMS+alignment), segment into moments, translate drafts (NLLB), human check, embed (e5), export model (ONNX int8), pack builder

nodes.label: Ask a question (guest's phone, offline)
nodes.description: decideSafety → embed query → top 3 moments → decide (confirm/saved/safety) → guest taps Yes to play or No to save

nodes.label: Sync outbox to backend
nodes.description: SyncService listens for online event; posts batches to ingest; redacts; upserts on client UUID

nodes.label: Monthly report and SMS
nodes.description: pg_cron calls monthly-summary; counts guests/orders/themes; fills checked template; reviewer approves; send-sms sends or logs

nodes.label: New answer loop (Noor records)
nodes.description: Noor records new clip; pipeline rebuilds pack v+1; service worker detects new manifest; UI shows update banner

nodes.label: Pack download with verification
nodes.description: Workbox precaches app shell; farm pack fetches once into named cache; SHA-256 checksums verified

nodes.label: SafetyCard component
nodes.description: Shows guide-and-emergency card for health/safety questions; never stored

nodes.label: decideSafety(text)
nodes.description: Whole-word match against multilingual safety lexicon; conservative by design. Returns boolean

nodes.label: decide(results, thresholds)
nodes.description: Pure; takes best score; at/above match → confirm, below → saved. Never returns safety

nodes.label: themeOf(text)
nodes.description: Device-side keyword hints for fixed taxonomy; returns ThemeId or 'other'

nodes.label: fillTemplate(template, counts, labels)
nodes.description: Only known placeholders; throws on unknown; drops lowest-priority parts until fits 2 SMS segments

nodes.label: redact(text)
nodes.description: Replaces emails with [email], 7+ digit phone runs with [phone]; stops on Gambian formats

nodes.label: packages/core
nodes.description: Pure TypeScript domain: types, guardrails, themes, safety lexicon, SMS templates. No React, no I/O

nodes.label: apps/web
nodes.description: React PWA. Guest tour at /, cooperative dashboard at /coop

nodes.label: pipeline
nodes.description: Python build-time pipeline. Transcribes, translates, embeds, quantizes, builds packs, evaluates

nodes.label: supabase
nodes.description: Postgres with RLS, Edge Functions (Deno), Auth, cron. Backend for data, auth, functions, scheduling

nodes.label: farms table
nodes.description: Farm metadata: id (UUID), name, cooperative, noor_lang, created_at

nodes.label: questions table
nodes.description: Guest questions: id, farm_id, lang, text, device_theme, cloud_theme, final_theme, created_at, synced_at

nodes.label: feedback table
nodes.description: Feedback: loved, change, themes (device, cloud, final), created_at, synced_at

nodes.label: orders table
nodes.description: Orders: items (JSON), total, currency, confirmed_by_noor, created_at

nodes.label: monthly_reports table
nodes.description: Period, counts, body, status (held/ready/approved/sent/failed), approved_by, sent_at

nodes.label: ingest Edge Function
nodes.description: Validates items with Zod; redacts emails/phones; upserts on client UUID; rejects unknown farms

nodes.label: monthly-summary Edge Function
nodes.description: Counts guests/orders/themes; fills checked template; held if unchecked; upserts monthly_reports

nodes.label: send-sms Edge Function
nodes.description: Requires approved status; SMS adapter or demo-mode log; updates status to sent/failed

nodes.label: multilingual-e5-small
nodes.description: ONNX int8 (135.4 MB full, 44.3 MB trimmed). Guest phone embeds queries; pipeline embeds passages

nodes.label: e5 Web Worker (Matcher)
nodes.description: Loads Transformers.js with local files only; embeds query; computes dot products; returns top k moments

nodes.label: PackRepository service
nodes.description: Download, cache, update check, checksum verification; implements Workbox caching

nodes.label: SyncService
nodes.description: Listens for online; posts batches to ingest; retries with backoff; marks synced

nodes.label: Outbox (Dexie/IndexedDB)
nodes.description: Stores questions, feedback, orders locally with device UUID; survives app restarts

nodes.label: Node.js 24 LTS
nodes.description: Active LTS; tooling runtime for all Node-based CLIs

nodes.label: React 19.3
nodes.description: Latest stable (released 2026-09-09); TypeScript strict

nodes.label: Vite 8.3
nodes.description: Build tool with @vitejs/plugin-react; no Babel, React Compiler off

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.description: Design tokens as CSS variables; no config file

nodes.label: Noor's language: Wolof (wo) or Gujarati (gu)
nodes.description: SMS templates and order line in Noor's language; Wolof drafts unchecked

nodes.label: Offline-first
nodes.description: Core tour, ask flow, feedback, shop all work in airplane mode after one pack download

nodes.label: AI dubbing with consent
nodes.description: ElevenLabs dubs checked clips only for people with confirmed consent rows; always labeled 'AI-dubbed'

nodes.label: Disclosed stand-in voice
nodes.description: Preet's English recordings with label 'Voice: Preet, standing in for Noor' can ship in production until Noor records

nodes.label: ElevenLabs narrator audio for add-ons
nodes.description: AI narrator voice (not Noor's, never cloned) for fun facts, recipe, products in visitor languages; always labeled 'AI narrator voice'

nodes.label: Farm pack
nodes.description: FarmPackManifest + audio + WebVTT + embeddings + ONNX model. Production has checked content only; demo includes labeled drafts

nodes.label: FarmPackManifest
nodes.description: JSON: packId, farmId, clips, moments, addons, model, embeddings, thresholds, sizes, checksums, labels

nodes.label: Theme taxonomy (16 IDs)
nodes.description: Fixed enum: stay, food, buy, price, path, kids, roast, picking, story, view, welcome, taste, length, wifi, transport, other

nodes.label: Meta MMS speech-to-text
nodes.description: Pipeline step: transcribes recordings with forced alignment for word timestamps. Non-commercial license.

nodes.label: NLLB-200 distilled 600M translation
nodes.description: Draft subtitles sentence-by-sentence. CC-BY-NC-4.0. All output marked unchecked.

nodes.label: Groq (P1, cooperative side only)
nodes.description: Cross-checks device themes with strict JSON schema; never reaches guests or Noor; feeds review queue only

nodes.label: ElevenLabs (build-time AI)
nodes.description: Narrator audio for add-ons (P1); AI dubbing and speech-to-text only with confirmed consent

nodes.label: Matcher (Web Worker)
nodes.description: On-device e5 embeddings for question matching; no text generation

nodes.label: Sync & Outbox
nodes.description: Local IndexedDB outbox; syncs to Edge Function when signal returns

nodes.label: Fixed theme enum
nodes.description: Feedback themes as fixed enum; Groq validates with JSON schema
